name: isParseable

versions.rationale: One rule for which files the configured adapters read, shared by scope, poetics index, verify's change check, backfill and the MCP code view. Each had its own TypeScript-only regex, which left .svelte units out of matching and made index mint duplicates.

docs:
Whether the configured adapters read `file`: TypeScript sources other than
declaration files, and `.svelte` components when `svelte` is configured (ADR 0020).
